adventurer_v1:bar_drink.name: bar_drink
adventurer_v1:bar_drink.reference_notes: At the beach bar: reach for a coconut drink, lower it, raise to lips and sip, then lower and return it before standing. Play once. Keep feet, costume palette and head scale fixed; the counter belongs to the scene.

adventurer_v1:beach_dig.name: beach_dig
adventurer_v1:beach_dig.reference_notes: Dig gently in beach sand with a short spade: plant, press, lift, flick sand forward. Keep feet anchored and head size/costume palette constant. Two cycles, then proceed. Sand is a small transient sprite effect; do not include a permanent background or scene.

adventurer_v1:balance_mild.name: balance_mild
adventurer_v1:balance_mild.reference_notes: Four-frame mild balance reaction, facing right: upright ready stance, lean left with arms extending for balance, lean right with arms extending, then recover upright. Play once at 4 FPS; mirror the entire strip for the opposite reaction. Keep boot contact, canvas alignment, head size, costume and palette consistent. Follow each skeleton rather than sliding the whole character.

adventurer_v1:balance_strong.name: balance_strong
adventurer_v1:balance_strong.reference_notes: Four-frame strong balance / shake reaction, facing right: raise hands defensively, recoil backward with bent knees, pitch forward with both hands out, then recover upright. Play once at 4 FPS; mirror the entire strip for the opposite reaction. Preserve boot contact and character scale while the torso rotates and knees bend. Keep all hands inside the canvas and keep identity, costume and palette unchanged.

adventurer_v1:talking.name: talking
adventurer_v1:talking.reference_notes: Stand facing the camera, feet and body fixed. Animate a clearly readable mouth: closed, open, wide open, rounded. Preserve identity, head size and clothing palette. Mouth details supplement the unchanged standing skeleton.

adventurer_v1:wave_hello.name: wave_hello
adventurer_v1:wave_hello.reference_notes: Friendly one-handed welcome-back wave. Keep the same hand raised in every frame; the other arm rests at the side. Small wrist motion only. Two-handed waving is reserved for attention alerts.
